name: context7-mcp
title_zh: 报出版本号再开口的库文档问答器
tagline_zh: 问 React 报错，它先反问你是 18 还是 19——版本不同答案天差地别。装它。
tagline_en: Ask about React errors—it asks 18 or 19 first. Version changes everything. Install to give your AI live official.
desc_en: This skill should be used when the user asks about libraries, frameworks, API references, or needs code examples. Activates for setup questions, code generation involving libraries, or mentions of specific frameworks like React, Vue, Next.js, Prisma, Supabase, etc.
why_zh: 不靠训练数据里的旧记忆，而是按你报的版本号实时拉取对应文档。
why_en: No stale training memory—it fetches docs for the exact version you name. Structurally kills the 'v4 answer to a v5 question'.
limit_zh: 只覆盖文档公开可查的内容；私有仓库、未发布版本、需登录的团队文档查不到。回答质量取决于你给对版本号。
limit_en: Only public docs; no private repos, unreleased versions, or auth-gated team wikis. Needs a clear version number—vague errors trigger follow-up.
title_en: Library docs Q&A that asks your version first
